caption: The drawing depicts a richly decorated billiard room with a Victorian or ornate style. At the center, there is a billiards table with a carved gold base, green felt, cue sticks, and billiard balls arranged for play. Directly above the table hang two large, green-shaded lamps suspended from the ceiling by gold fixtures, while an elaborate gold scoring apparatus stands at the rear center. Behind the billiards table is a dark, tufted leather sofa that spans most of the back wall. On both sides of this sofa are round tables with decorative vases and large potted palm-like plants. The walls are covered in a patterned reddish-pink wallpaper with ornate wooden trim and molding, and there are two tall, arched stained glass windows featuring figures of women in classical attire, one on each side of the back wall. The ceiling is decorated with wooden beams and gold light fixtures. To the left is a dark, tufted leather armchair adjacent to a wooden panel holding billiard accessories, including colored balls, scoring pegs, and a triangle rack that also leans against the wall. There is also an elaborate table lamp with a beige fringed shade, blue base, and gold details on a wood table in the left foreground. On the right side, another ornate mahogany armchair with gold patterned upholstery sits in the foreground, and a gold statue lamp featuring a figure mounts a small side table nearby. A mounted animal head with curling horns is on the wall above the right stained glass window. The floor features intricate patterned rugs, with a visible brown border around the billiards table, and gold and blue design elements throughout the room.
title: Pool Room, 1910
